g.text: collected using commit 08fc958a on hilbert • serial native C calls • deterministic paired inputs • factors verified • generated 2026-10-25 UTC
Samples/digit: 160 (15–39), 40 (40–60), 20 (61–75), 5 (76–80), 3 (81–100) • RSS includes runtime, warmup and allocator overhead.
No-split calls: TinyQS 1/4120; SIMPQS 4/2774 • No-split times retained in medians and bands.
MPU never used TinyQS past 126 bits • SIMPQS capped at 83 digits due to no-splits • unfinished groups omitted
